THE ECHO BELOW · SCENE
Area 16 · Booming cavern
Change prepared scene
Say aloud

The passage ends above churning water. A surge races through the dark and strikes beneath the ledge with a crash you feel in your chest. Then the water sinks back, leaving a long, hollow roar.

Each surge changes the sound of the cavern, filling the spaces between words before falling away again. The water and the stone around it are visible things to study. You can keep back from its edge, watch the rhythm, or inspect the route without entering the water.

Ask the players

Do you watch a full cycle, test the ledge, enter the water, or turn back?
